source: src/e2e/probes/input-box.e2e.ts, run with NOVADECK_E2E_PROBES=1 (2026-10-07; 0.163.0 with the tall states, 2026-10-18)
how: Each harness driven in a PTY (120x40) by the end-to-end deck against the fake model; keys and pastes written as the person would; each state read with `screenText`: `rows` holds the rows that show anything, `bright` the rows whose dim cells blank some of their text (`screenText`'s bright rows), `cursor` the cursor. The box was cleared between states with repeated Ctrl-U and Backspace; the state 12 onward come after one turn, 14 to 17 while a turn is held mid-flight. The `tall 40 lines at <rows> rows` states (0.163.0) paste forty short lines at each of four screen heights, the screen resized first, to see how much of a text taller than the box it shows; 0.163.0 has no `queued` states, which no current probe records.
